| 6         | Set blower to speed X | Set pressure to Y    | Yes                    | Yes                   | Checks at boundary values | Pass |
| 7         | Set blower to speed X | Set pressure to Y    | Yes                    | Yes                   | Error path (sensor failure) | Fail |
| 8         | Set blower to speed X | Set pressure to Y    | Yes                    | Yes                   | No impact from '-' values | Pass |
